entities.summary: Or Akiva is a city in the Haifa District of Israel, on the country's coastal plain. It is located inland from the ancient port city of Caesarea and the Mediterranean Sea, and to the north of the city of Hadera. It is 39 kilometres south of Haifa and 48 km (30 mi) north of Tel Aviv. In 2024 it had a population of 25,922.
